newsitem.title: TANZANIA: Tanzanian shilling continues fall on dollar.
newsitem.headline: Tanzanian shilling continues fall on dollar.

text.p: The Tanzanian shilling continued weaker versus the dollar on Wednesday on dollar demand from corporates, commercial and central bank dealers said.
They said the shilling was posted at a commercial mean rate of 608.256 against the dollar compared to 608.2362 on Tuesday.
The shilling fell to 992.2191 against the pound compared to 987.3209 on Tuesday. Dealers blamed the shilling-pound movements on international currency trends.
Dealers said there was demand for dollars in the interbank market and available dollars were swiftly snapped up by corporates who wanted to meet their obligations.
